description: A plant-floor operations view in Svelte 5: KPI cards for OEE and throughput on top, a live line-status grid below and an active-alarms grid alongside, all driven by a single 2-second tick. The KPIs are $derived from the grid data, cells and cards colour by threshold, and an Acknowledge button lives inside an alarm cell through renderSnippet and a closure, showing two SvGrid instances working next to other UI in one screen.

faq.question: How do the KPI cards stay in sync with the grid?
faq.answer: They are $derived values over the same lines array the grid renders, so the tick that updates the rows updates the cards in the same pass.

faq.question: How is the Acknowledge button wired?
faq.answer: The alarm column's cell returns renderSnippet with a closure over the alarm id; clicking it marks the alarm acknowledged in state and the row re-renders.

faq.question: Do both grids need separate tick loops?
faq.answer: No. One interval mutates the lines, recomputes the KPIs and spawns alarms; each grid just reflects its own array.
